entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter used in NAS security procedures that can wrap around when approaching its maximum value (close to 2^24).

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity responsible for detecting NAS COUNT wrap around conditions and initiating appropriate security procedures.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that handles NAS COUNT wrap around conditions and performs corresponding security actions.

entities.name: EPS AKA procedure
entities.description: Authentication and Key Agreement procedure used to establish a new EPS security context and reset NAS COUNT to 0.

entities.name: EPS security context
entities.description: Security context containing cryptographic keys and parameters for NAS protection, which can be current or non-current.

entities.name: NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Procedure to release the NAS signalling connection when NAS COUNT wraps around without new KASME establishment.

entities.name: EIA0 used as NAS integrity algorithm
entities.description: Condition where EIA0 (null integrity algorithm) is used, allowing NAS COUNT wrap around without security context changes.

entities.name: KASME
entities.description: Key used in EPS security context that must be established before NAS COUNT wrap around to avoid connection release.

entities.name: eKSI
entities.description: EPS Key Set Identifier indicating the current EPS security context, which the UE deletes before sending next uplink NAS message if NAS COUNT wraps without new KASME.

relations.description: MME initiates EPS AKA procedure when NAS COUNT is close to wrap around and no suitable non-current security context exists.
EPS AKA procedure resets NAS COUNT to 0 in both UE and MME when new EPS security context is activated.
MME can activate non-current native EPS security context with low NAS COUNT values when wrap around is detected.
UE releases NAS signalling connection if NAS COUNT wraps around without new KASME establishment.
UE deletes eKSI indicating current EPS security context before sending next uplink NAS message if NAS COUNT wraps without new KASME.
When EIA0 is used, UE and MME continue using current security context even after NAS COUNT wrap around.
MME shall not initiate EPS AKA procedure when EIA0 is used and NAS COUNT wrap around occurs.
MME and UE shall not release NAS signalling connection when EIA0 is used and NAS COUNT wrap around occurs.
